# A 1280x720 window at GUI scale 3 (426x240), with the made-up songs: all six made-up playlists in French and Spanish
# show their count after a note ("♪ 7", "♪ 13"...) under their covers, where "7 chansons", "13 chansons",
# "7 canciones", "13 canciones" and the others ended in "…".
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f script=.github/checks/fit-fixes2-426.txt

cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
sleep 6
guiscale 3
set demoMode true
set libraryView GRID

lang fr_fr
sleep 15
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
# The library opens on the liked songs; Tab goes on to the playlists
key tab
sleep 3
shot fit2-playlists-fr-426
close

# It opens again where it was left: on the playlists
lang es_es
sleep 15
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot fit2-playlists-es-426
close
